import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()
new=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','apps/client/src','apps/client/tests'],text=True).splitlines()
paths=sorted({p for p in changed+new if p.startswith('apps/client/') and Path(p).suffix in {'.ts','.tsx','.cjs'} and Path(p).is_file()})
print('Changed client source/test/config files:',len(paths),flush=True)
a=subprocess.run([str(root/'node_modules/.bin/prettier'),'--check',*paths])
source=[p.removeprefix('apps/client/') for p in paths if p.startswith('apps/client/src/') or p=='apps/client/app/_layout.tsx']
b=subprocess.run([str(root/'node_modules/.bin/eslint'),*source,'--rule','prettier/prettier: off'],cwd=root/'apps/client')
print('Prettier exit:',a.returncode,'ESLint exit:',b.returncode)
raise SystemExit(max(a.returncode,b.returncode))
